title: help stranded elevator rivals
context: Y1 Volume 4.5 final summer vacation episode. Later flashbacks and private narration do not imply global contemporaneous knowledge.
observed_actions: Responds to Kiyotaka and Ibuki's confinement and assists them when they cannot exit on their own.
observed_result: Two adults remotely operate the elevator from the first floor, allowing Kiyotaka and Ibuki to exit. Kiyotaka credits Katsuragi, who says he received the account by phone; the simultaneous button presses by the trapped pair did not operate the elevator.
epistemic_limits: The source does not show Katsuragi himself operating the elevator control; technical rescue was carried out by adults outside. Kiyotaka attributes coordination to Katsuragi, without proof of the exact staff sequence.
information_available: Actor-scoped at actual event time only. Later source explanations can refine the dossier without backdating belief, especially in retrospective final chapter.
counterfactual_test: Different support, actor health, social context and private knowledge may change the result; no forced repetition or universal success.
